## Scope Summary

- Compose canonical authenticated recovery storage through the existing sole checkpoint writer's ComposeRecoveryStage(proposalStore, keyStore). Its exact datasource, writer and clock are retained. Initial Stage and precommit Stage execute in the existing checkpoint transaction; request callers cannot replace those dependencies. Source composition commits are 9500b68678fd661af0d43ea53ad2b92224feee94 and 523bb36ead10f281419d1829aef9c0f3d040f0f6.
- Add seven ordinary composition cases to the existing canonical transaction test class, with six unchanged original transaction cases as controls. Cover real authenticated append/replay, same database/controlled clock, missing existing key, checkpoint SQL rollback, and precommit expiry/key/cancellation revalidation. Fixed public algorithm fixtures do not prove custody, snapshot provenance or native qualification.
- Exact tested source/test head is 00de5e3a203dc07568d18754b233ca1c42c5a866. No project, lock, shared registry, runtime DI/auth/transport or native implementation changed. PR3973/frozen3b526ec1f75b3a9aca53f5b1bf6437fef54e7397 and the earlier source-only draft d2eb22645c1a24f3fe30e9f249948804c1c59682 remain immutable.
